title: Lando System?
caption: Lando System? (V)
game_text: ▲ Lando or a card with “Lando” in game text. OR Cancel an attempt to replace your Lando; opponent’s Lando is lost.
lore: “Lando’s not a system, he’s a man.” Regardless of where Rebels flee, dark agents are sure to follow.
